title: Beowulf, Lines 12–25
subtitle: The lineage of Scyld Scefing.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Old English poetry and prose.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body:
Oft Scyld Scēfing sceaþena þrēatum,
monegum mǣgþum, meodosetla oftēah...

'Often Scyld son of Sceaf from enemy hosts, from many tribes, took away the mead-benches...'

Genealogical formulas. The past tense narrative of Scyld's conquests and reign.
